# Awesome Meets

> Awesome Meets is one-to-one networking in Helsinki. It introduces people to someone new from their field, and the two meet in person over lunch, coffee or a walk.

Awesome Meets is run by Anna Pogrebniak, founder of The Awesome Marketers, an English-speaking marketing community founded in Helsinki in 2019. It is not an event and not an app: each person is matched with one other person at a time.

## How it works

1. You tell Awesome Meets about your interests, your industry and your profession.
2. Every person in the community is reviewed before they are matched.
3. You are matched with someone you have something in common with, never at random.
4. The two of you meet in person in Helsinki.

## Facts

- City: Helsinki, Finland. A waitlist is open for people in other cities.
- Round one: October 2026, for marketers from The Awesome Marketers community. 40 people joined.
- Next round: planned for November 2026. The waitlist for November is open.
- Awesome Meets is not only for marketers.

## Pages

- [Home](https://awesomemeets.com/): what Awesome Meets is and the two waitlists
- [Join](https://awesomemeets.com/join/): the waitlist for November, or the sign-up form while a round is open
- [About](https://awesomemeets.com/about/): who runs it, and answers to common questions
- [Data policy](https://awesomemeets.com/data/): what is collected, who sees it, how long it is kept
